title: Machine Generated Text: A Comprehensive Survey of Threat Models and Detection Methods
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable; the paper is a survey and does not conduct a benchmark. It identifies harassment of online communities formed around religion as a potential threat model for which machine-generated text could be used.
findings: The paper identifies that online communities formed around religion are at risk of 'brigading' from hate groups using Natural Language Generation (NLG) models to flood them with large volumes of abusive messages.
